data.long_meaning: Devnath is a combination of two words – ‘Dev’ meaning god and ‘Nath’ meaning lord or master. In Hindu mythology, Devnath refers to Lord Shiva, who is considered the god of gods and the lord of the universe. The name Devnath carries the meaning “God of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devnath usually hope their child will grow to embody god of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_sanskrit.name: Devnath
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The compound name 'Devnath' is derived from 'Deva' and 'Nath'. 'Deva' is a Sanskrit word meaning 'god'. 'Nath' is a Sanskrit word meaning 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, 'Devnath' means 'god of lords' or 'lord of gods'.

in_hindi.name: Devnāth

in_tamil.name: Thevanaathiru

in_telugu.name: Devanātha

data.spiritual_significance: The name Devnath holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. The name is associated with Lord Shiva, who represents the purest and highest form of spiritual consciousness. As the lord of the universe, Lord Shiva is believed to be the source of all creation, sustenance, and dissolution. Devotees believe that by invoking the name 'Devnath,' they can connect with the divine energy and attain spiritual growth and enlightenment. The spiritual significance of this name is further emphasized through various legends and stories in Hindu mythology, where Lord Shiva is portrayed as the ultimate savior and protector of devotees.
